name: StepFilter
description: Applies a filter with tempo-synced, periodically random cutoff values. Great for adding movement to long synth-pad chord patterns.

params.name: DEPTH
params.detail: How far each S&H step moves cutoff around CUT (± octaves)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the pad is held

params.name: CUT
params.detail: Center cutoff the S&H LFO modulates around

params.name: TYPE
params.detail: Filter mode: Peak, LP12, LP24, BPF, HP12, HP24

params.name: SMOOTH
params.detail: Cutoff glide: 0 = instant step, max = very slow blend toward each new S&H value

params.name: LEVEL
params.detail: Wet level into the final softclip
